description: This file defines React context providers and theming for embedded dashboards in Apache Superset, including theme storage, registry extensions, and composition of multiple context providers.

classes.name: ThemeMemoryStorageAdapter
classes.description: In-memory implementation of ThemeStorage interface for embedded contexts, providing getItem, setItem, and removeItem methods.

methods.name: getThemeController
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ThemeController.
